This page demonstrates the `include-in-header` strategy for loading macros. The YAML front matter of this file includes:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - macros.qmd
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - macros.qmd
  revealjs:
    include-in-header:
      - macros.qmd
  docx: default
```

> **Note:** This demo uses `macros.qmd` because `macros.qmd` is at the root of this repository. When using this repository as a Git submodule (cloned into a `macros/` subdirectory), replace `macros.qmd` with `macros/macros.qmd`.

The same configuration can be placed in a shared `_quarto.yml` to apply project-wide:

```yaml
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
  pdf:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
  revealjs:
    include-in-header:
      - macros/macros.qmd
```

This inserts `macros.qmd` verbatim into the document header for each output format. For LaTeX/PDF output, the macro definitions go into the LaTeX preamble. For HTML and RevealJS, MathJax processes the macro definitions.

> **Note for HTML/RevealJS output:** [MathJax v3](https://quarto.org/docs/authoring/markdown-basics.html#equations) supports `\def`, `\newcommand`, `\renewcommand`, `\newenvironment`, `\renewenvironment`, and `\let`, but **not** `\providecommand`. Macros defined with `\providecommand` in `macros.qmd` will work correctly in PDF output but may not render in HTML/RevealJS when loaded via `include-in-header`. The example table below uses only `\def`-based macros, which work in all formats. The [Macro Reference](macros-table.qmd) page handles this automatically by converting `\providecommand` to `\def` in its embedded macro block.

## Example math

The table below uses macros defined with `\def` in `macros.qmd`, which work in all output formats including HTML/MathJax:

| Description | Code | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Greek: alpha | `$\a$` | $\a$ |
| Greek: beta | `$\b$` | $\b$ |
| Greek: gamma | `$\g$` | $\g$ |
| Greek: lambda | `$\l$` | $\l$ |
| Greek: sigma | `$\s$` | $\s$ |
| Log-likelihood | `$\llik$` | $\llik$ |
| Independent | `$X \ind Y$` | $X \ind Y$ |
| IID distributed | `$X_i \siid \Normal(\m, \ss)$` | $X_i \siid \Normal(\m, \ss)$ |
| Design matrix | `$\mX \vb$` | $\mX \vb$ |
| Hat beta | `$\hb$` | $\hb$ |
